title: Production-readiness manifest and receipts
description: Declarative shape of releases/<version>/readiness.yaml and its receipts at releases/<version>/readiness/<leg>.receipt.json. The authoritative validator is release/readiness/check.mjs — this document states the same contract for readers and for tools that do not run the checker; release/readiness/check.test.mjs asserts the two do not drift.

release.description: Stable release this manifest covers. Candidate suffixes are stripped before lookup.

candidate_map.description: Must be releases/<release>/candidate-images.json — the frozen map every receipt binds to.

legs.description: Every one of the six standard legs must be represented; check.mjs refuses a manifest whose ordinals do not cover 1-6.

leg.description: Which of the six standard legs this row covers; a/b splits a leg with two oracles.

kind.description: machine legs are fired by a command; agent legs are executed by a session against a protocol document.

phase.description: Firing point. A staging run requires every leg regardless of this value; formation requires formation and both.

oracle.description: Exactly one of command | protocol. A machine leg declares a command; an agent leg declares a protocol document.

binds_candidate_map.description: Every leg binds the candidate map sha; a re-cut strands the receipt.

input.description: Human statement of this leg's own input identity — what its receipt's input_identity names.

input_pattern.description: Optional regular expression the receipt's input_identity must match.

stale_reason.description: Why this leg's coverage stops describing the candidate once the map is re-cut. Rendered verbatim in the stale failure.

leg.description: Must equal the manifest leg's id.

candidate_map_sha.description: sha256 of the candidate map file's bytes at the time the leg ran.

input_identity.description: The leg's own input identity — diff range, docs tree sha, probed base URL, roster snapshot.

findings_ref.description: Where the findings live: a GitHub URL or a repo-relative path. The receipt is a pointer plus a verdict.
